_doc: Chess boards per world, derived from maps2's placements (the tables are world PROPS at these cells — commit 5d7b39dfe3: 'one by the fire, one with Rannulf behind it'). seatA/seatB are the stand cells; standing at a free one makes the jump button the offer (chess.sit). `npc` names the resident opponent standing at seatB. sprite 'world' = the world's own prop renders the table, the game draws no decor. `bubble` = /assets path of the challenge speech-bubble art when it syncs (drawn fallback). Overridable per world via live/tuning/chess.json, same shape.
